To stop paying while you're not using Tallyfield, you have two options:
- Pause: if your plan is monthly, you can pause it for up to three months from the Account, Subscription page. A paused plan is not charged and keeps your data. Annual plans cannot be paused.
- Cancel: go to Account, Subscription, Cancel plan. Your dashboards stay available until the paid period ends. Reports are kept for 90 days after the plan ends, and you can export them to CSV from any report before then.

If you'd like to discuss a plan change, please open a separate plan-change ticket.
